question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 E 组：厄瓜多尔 vs 德国（2026-06-25），90 分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group E: Ecuador vs Germany (2026-06-25), three-way result after 90 minutes?
one_liner_cn: Elo 几乎持平（1938 vs 1932），厄瓜多尔状态与防守小幅占优、德国多点带伤，三路接近均势、略倾向厄瓜多尔。
one_liner_en: Elo virtually level (1938 vs 1932); Ecuador's form and defense edge a Germany side carrying knocks - near coin-flip, slight tilt to Ecuador.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 仅差 6 分：厄瓜多尔 1938（世界第 9）vs 德国 1932（世界第 10），中立场地无东道主加成。
key_reasons.en: Only 6 Elo points apart: Ecuador 1938 (world #9) vs Germany 1932 (world #10), neutral venue with no host bonus.

key_reasons.cn: 厄瓜多尔 19 场不败，热身 3-0 危地马拉、2-1 沙特（后者就在本场场地新泽西），预选赛 18 轮仅失 5 球。
key_reasons.en: Ecuador unbeaten in 19, warm-up wins 3-0 vs Guatemala and 2-1 vs Saudi Arabia (the latter at this match's New Jersey venue), and only 5 goals conceded in 18 qualifiers.

key_reasons.cn: 德国伤情存疑：诺伊尔小腿伤缺席全部热身赛、穆夏拉骨折后仍在找状态、格纳布里反复、卡尔伤退。
key_reasons.en: Germany carries fitness doubts: Neuer (calf) missed both friendlies, Musiala still building rhythm after a broken leg, Gnabry had a setback, Karl withdrew injured.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) gives 37.7/25.9/36.4; bounded evidence adjustment of +1.5/+1.0/-2.5pp (cap 8pp) for Ecuador form+fitness vs Germany injury doubts; renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus 14-days-out evidence uncertainty.
